edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by the _msgSender helper.
_msgSender is assigned to _owner during construction, establishing privileged ownership.
transfer uses _msgSender as the token sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender as spender when reducing allowance.
transfer delegates to the private _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the private _transfer routine.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which pushes ETH out of the contract.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
openTrading performs the payable router.addLiquidityETH external call.
openTrading assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading updates _maxTxAmount for the cooldown limit.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee executes the ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.
manualswap requires _msgSender to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend requires _msgSender to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the comparison target that gates manualswap.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the comparison target that gates manualsend.
One third of the ETH amount is transferred to _feeAddrWallet1.
One third of the ETH amount is transferred to _feeAddrWallet2.
One third of the ETH amount is transferred to _feeAddrWallet3.
bots[from] blacklist check can abort a transfer in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount during cooldown checks.
cooldownEnabled decides whether the max transaction check applies.
inSwap guards automatic swap/fee logic against recursive execution.
lockTheSwap sets and resets inSwap around the swap routine.
_transfer updates the reflection balances stored in _rOwned.
_transfer reduces _rTotal through the reflection fee accounting.
amount parameter drives the transfer value processing in _transfer.
from parameter is used for the bots blacklist check.
to parameter becomes the credited recipient in _transfer.
tAmount feeds reflection and fee arithmetic computed for the transfer.
contractTokenBalance is passed as the amount to sell in swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee for distribution.
tokenAmount is the input token amount swapped for ETH.
amount is split into thirds and pushed to the fee wallets.
rAmount is subtracted from the sender reflection balance.
currentRate converts between reflection and token amounts during swapping.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter local to _transfer and only meaningful within it.
to is a parameter local to _transfer and only meaningful within it.
amount is a parameter local to _transfer and only meaningful within it.
tAmount belongs to the standard transfer path invoked by _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is the value consumed by the swap routine.
contractETHBalance is the value consumed by the fee distribution routine.
tokenAmount is the parameter of swapTokensForEth.
amount is the parameter of sendETHToFee.
rAmount is an intermediate reflection value computed inside the transfer flow.
currentRate is an intermediate conversion value used during swap accounting.
